page.overview:
What is Purple Dye?

Purple dye is a secondary dye color created by combining red dye and blue dye in a crafting grid.

Wandering traders sometimes sell 3 purple dye for an emerald.

Apprentice-level Shepherd villagers have a 20% chance to buy 12 purple dye for an emerald as part of their trades.

Expert-level Shepherd villagers have a chance to buy 12 purple dye for an emerald.
